entries.name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B

step_urls.license: unspecified - community model, accuracy unverified: cross-checked against the official drawing, see notes
step_urls.note: Community model (multigamesystem/MGS-CAD-Files), no official Pi 4 STEP exists. Downloaded and imported 2026-10-02: 109 solids, PCB 85 x 56 x 1.6, holes 58 x 49 at (3.5, 3.5), connector centres within 0.2 mm of the drawing-based boxes (audio jack 0.5 mm); the model reaches 1 to 2 mm further past the board edges. The board file keeps the drawing values (see its step_cross_check).

entries.name: Raspberry Pi 5

step_urls.license: vendor-published, see vendor terms (the archive's LICENSE.txt: MIT, Raspberry Pi Ltd; the model is provided for guidance only, without guarantee of accuracy)
step_urls.note: Official Raspberry Pi 5 STEP (RP-010083-CA, 'No Graphics small file'); the URL redirects to pip-assets.raspberrypi.com. A LARGE model: 2689 solids, 77.6 MB unpacked, importing takes several minutes. Measured 2026-10-02: PCB 85 x 56 x 1.276, holes 58 x 49 at (3.5, 3.5); no micro-HDMI shells in the model.
